description: Defines the ue_manager class for managing UE contexts, including configuration, dependencies, and asynchronous task scheduling within a 5G/NR network component.

classes.name: ue_manager
classes.description: Manages UE contexts, handles their lifecycle, and schedules asynchronous tasks related to UEs.

methods.name: get_next_ue_index
methods.description: Retrieves the next available UE index for assigning to a new UE.

methods.name: schedule_and_wait_ue_removal
methods.description: Schedules and waits for the removal of a UE identified by its index.
